svg.title: Eventually every summand is nonnegative, T > 0, and T →∞. The vector with coordinates log(1/sv)/T belongs to the finite compact cube [0, 1]Inner(t). On a nontrivial refining filter it con- verges to a; summing the coordinates proves P v av = 1. Hence each sv has rate −av on that filter. Monotonicity sv ≤sparent(v) implies av ≥aparent(v), since the opposite strict inequality would eventually force the smaller radius to exceed the larger one by the exponential-rate comparison. Take the virtual parent exponent to be zero.
